description: Defines the `absl::Cleanup` class implementing scope guard idiom for resource cleanup, including methods for cancellation and invocation, with usage examples and internal implementation details.

classes.name: absl::Cleanup
classes.description: A scope guard class that executes a callback upon destruction unless canceled, supporting move semantics and optional early invocation.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Prevents the callback from executing during destruction.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Executes the callback early and prevents it from executing again during destruction.
